transcript.text: Good morning, everyone. Let's get started with the 0700 power-control board meeting. We've got four activities that need to be scheduled across today's power-control period from 0800 to 1600: the generator load test, clinic refrigeration transfer, communications-battery recharge, and water-point pumping. As you all know, the main generator can only support one of these high-load activities at a time, so we need to assign each to one of the four two-hour blocks: 0800-1000, 1000-1200, 1200-1400, or 1400-1600. Before I publish the schedule, I need each section to report any changes or constraints that might affect the timing. Who wants to start?
